# githubsettings_organization_private_fork_workflows (Resource)

Manages whether workflows from private fork pull requests run across an organization and whether they receive write tokens, secrets, and variables. Requires a token with organization administration write access.

Removing this resource from Terraform management leaves the GitHub setting in place.

## Import the current setting

Add the import block below to a Terraform project configured with `elephant-evergreen/githubsettings`. The [quickstart](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/elephant-evergreen/githubsettings/latest/docs#import-a-policy) shows the provider block and initialization. Replace the example ID and address with those of your resource.

```terraform
import {
  to = githubsettings_organization_private_fork_workflows.example
  id = "example-owner"
}
```

1. Add the resource block with arguments that match the current GitHub values.
2. Run `terraform plan -out=adopt.tfplan` and keep a plan that contains only the import. If it proposes a change, compare the differing values with the current policy and save a new plan.
3. Apply the saved plan.

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "githubsettings_organization_private_fork_workflows" "example" {
  owner                                  = "example-owner"
  run_workflows_from_fork_pull_requests  = false
  send_write_tokens_to_workflows         = false
  send_secrets_and_variables             = false
  require_approval_for_fork_pr_workflows = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `owner` (String) GitHub account that owns the repository or organization.
- `require_approval_for_fork_pr_workflows` (Boolean) Require approval before running workflows from fork pull requests.
- `run_workflows_from_fork_pull_requests` (Boolean) Run workflows from fork pull requests.
- `send_secrets_and_variables` (Boolean) Send secrets and variables to workflows from fork pull requests.
- `send_write_tokens_to_workflows` (Boolean) Send write tokens to workflows from fork pull requests.
